game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders +4.0 with a fair total of 49.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits +0.141 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Los Angeles Rams and Washington Commanders have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
